236-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
236-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
236-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

512-2085-4137.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1531-3944-5220-6900.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2557-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-2557-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1429-4779-6982.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

4399-4770-5870-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
4399-4770-5870-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1274-4506-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4506-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4063-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2713-3767-4452-4465.description:
Activate Rukarumel by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token using the ability granted to it by Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Rukarumel using the ability granted to it by Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping Rukarumel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4565-4762-4772.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

997-2577-7390.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

206-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1477-4559-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1477-4559-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4050-5078-6766-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2783-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

104-671-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-671-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4377-6122-6991.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Donnie & April from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
4377-6122-6991.notes: If you cast Donnie & April from the command zone to start, you must be able to pay for commander tax that first turn.

359-372-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-3227.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

129-3812-4474.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3812-4474.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2173-2511-5220-6538.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2811-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers twice, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2811-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

439-2440-4050-6456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dragons.
439-2440-4050-6456.description:
Cast Breaching Dragonstorm by paying {4}{R}.
When Breaching Dragonstorm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to exile Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost.
When Arashin Sovereign enters the battlefield, Breaching Dragonstorm's second ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Breaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding {R}.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4871-5189-6441.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
4871-5189-6441.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2061-3617-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2061-3617-4125.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2084-4662.description:
Cast Mirror-Mad Phantasm by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Mirror-Mad Phantasm enters the battlefield, Unstable Shapeshifter triggers, causing Unstable Shapeshifter to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Unstable Shapeshifter by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Unstable Shapeshifter into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

997-1548-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
997-1548-4897.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Port Razer, scrying 1.
Repeat.
